18
Case Id: POS-0326
Engine type: ME-LGIP
System: 21-4220
Responsible init.: PPH Date: 6/9 - 2021
Description:
• Atomizers are clogging after few service hours (200 – 1000 RH).
• Clogging observed even without LPG operation (S60ME-LGIP)
Root cause:
• Build up of residue from cylinder lube oil and/or sealing oil.
• Deposit content analyzed – main components O, C, Ca, S  and fragments of Fe, Zn, P, Al, Na.  Indicating deposit mainly contains Calcium oxide.
• Source is either cylinder lubricant or sealing oil
[Pictures]

and deposit

19

• Service test of new atomizer designs on G50 and G60 LGIP engines
• S60 LGIP will have design 2 for upcoming new building
• R&D test planned during FAT:  G60 2022-Q2  and G50 2022-Q3
• Engines with problems in service will receive new atomizers upon service test 
confirmation and amendments approved by classification societies.
Conclusion:
• Await service and R&D test
Solution:
• Change the design of the atomizer similar to what we have found to have a 
positive effect for ME-GI atomizers.
ME-GI engines are using the same Extra Short design, and showed similar 
problems.
